sources.title: Ecommerce UX Audit: How to Find What's Hurting Your Conversion
sources.takeaway: Checkout and shipping/tax surprises are leading abandonment drivers; audit against heuristics.

sources.title: Ecommerce UX That Converts: 2026 Guide
sources.takeaway: Reviews near add-to-cart, guest checkout, free-shipping progress.

sources.title: GEO for ecommerce: How to get your products cited by AI search engines
sources.takeaway: Complete Product schema, crawlable pages, answer-first copy.

sources.title: AEO/GEO playbook for Shopify brands
sources.takeaway: Brand-owned FAQs, policies, sizing guides are what AI cites.

sources.title: Generative Engine Optimization for Shopify
sources.takeaway: Allow AI crawlers (OAI-SearchBot etc.); claims unverified by OpenAI docs.

sources.title: How To Add Merchant Listing Structured Data
sources.takeaway: Product markup with price, availability, shipping and returns makes pages eligible for merchant listings; missing fields trigger warnings.

sources.title: Merchant Return Policy Structured Data
sources.takeaway: hasMerchantReturnPolicy can live at Organization level; merchantReturnDays required for finite windows.

sources.title: More ways to share your shipping and returns policies with Google
sources.takeaway: Org-level shipping policy markup now supported; Merchant Center/Search Console settings take precedence.

sources.title: Fragrances in Cosmetics
sources.takeaway: Fragrance can be listed as 'Fragrance' on label; MoCRA fragrance-allergen labeling rule still to be set. Confirm compliance with counsel.

sources.title: MoCRA overview
sources.takeaway: Small-business exemptions cover registration/listing/GMP, not labeling; product listing with ingredients is annual.

sources.title: Agentic Commerce for Shopify Merchants 2026
sources.takeaway: Agentic Storefronts reportedly on by default for eligible US merchants; thin product data means exclusion from AI shortlists. Unverified vs Shopify docs.

sources.title: Ecommerce Technical SEO Statistics 2026
sources.takeaway: CWV targets LCP<=2.5s, INP<=200ms, CLS<=0.1; conversion-loss stats are vendor-reported, directional only.
